item.title: Drainage Improvement Project – Valleywood Rd / Old Post Rd #6 / East Putnam Ave
item.description: The Town of Greenwich Department of Public Works Engineering Division will begin a drainage improvement project in the vicinity of Valleywood Road, Old Post Road #6, and East Putnam Avenue this Spring.
